summary: __thiscall setter that writes a caller-supplied dword (a2) into the field at offset 0x20 of the object pointed to by *this, and returns the original object pointer unchanged.

operations.description: Dereference this to capture the target object pointer stored at this+0 into result.
Write parameter a2 to the dword field at offset 0x20 of the target object (*this + 0x20).
Return the object pointer captured before the write; the sole known caller is ConfigIniParser (00421CD0).

unresolved: Semantic role of the 0x20 field on the target object is unknown; this function only provides setter access.
The object type behind *this is an unknown allocation owned by the ConfigIniParser path.
